reviewedBehavior: The explicit MainActor helper issues a fresh UUID per activation/retry, retains selection identity, and rejects dispatch or publication after invalidation, replacement or caller cancellation. Late provider failures are retired with their original owner; a current provider error is rethrown unchanged.

The two Inspector entry loads, Reader initial/previous/next loads and expanded-source load all retain an explicit post-await current-request/cancellation guard before UI publication; error publication is similarly guarded. Source resolution uses the existing repository arguments and exact resolvers.

Retry obtains its request synchronously before creating its Task. Delayed retry tasks cannot reactivate a disappeared or differently selected owner. Structured entry tasks check cancellation before activation.

Reader initial load resets its local window/loading/state-machine state, then preserves the existing session snapshot and pending viewport restoration. Old defers cannot clear the new owner loading flags. The original seven-section cap, append/prepend order, window trimming and scroll decisions remain.

Pagination captures the current request before scheduling; state-machine completion/failure and pending viewport writes are fenced by that request. Viewport restore rechecks request, caller cancellation, pending viewport equality and segment membership after Task.yield before scrolling or saving the session.

Expanded-source scheduling captures the current focus request and duplicate in-flight source IDs are refused at actual task entry. Its successful/error/defer writes remain under that owner. Disappear invalidates expanded reads and advances the existing snippet generation; original snippet post-await/error/defer generation checks remain intact.

The original shared session, navigation path, full-source/search/return actions, provider arguments, theme/locale and source-rendering logic were read around the edits and are not replaced by the lifetime helper. All three supplied source files independently reverse exactly to their pinned9058 originals.

The six Foundation/MainActor helper test methods declare nine cases covering late success/error, different selection, same-ID retry/reactivation, caller/pre-call cancellation, invalidated dispatch and current provider error. The provider checks cancellation at entry and the real read continuation has a finite deadline and cleanup. No test relies on a fabricated UI/native assertion.
remainingAcceptance: The source review is not execution of the six methods/nine cases or typechecking of the complete SwiftUI target.

Actual App/Kit compilation, mounted selection/retry/pagination/return flows, viewport behavior, locales/appearance/AX, visual and physical-device checks remain required on the matching shared product.
The pure helper tests cannot establish provider/native permissions, source identity on an actual screen, or full G04/reader acceptance.
